title: MapTerrain
description: Defines the terrain layout, entity placements, named coordinate regions, and camera settings for a Realm arcade map.

Width.description: Terrain grid width in cells. Also determines the pixel width of terrain_splat_*.exr files.

Depth.description: Terrain grid depth (Z axis) in cells. Also determines the pixel height of terrain_splat_*.exr files.

CameraBoundsLeft.description: Left edge of the playable camera boundary in world space (X axis).

CameraBoundsRight.description: Right edge of the playable camera boundary in world space (X axis).

CameraBoundsTop.description: Top edge (near Z) of the playable camera boundary in world space (Z axis, negative = top).

CameraBoundsBottom.description: Bottom edge (far Z) of the playable camera boundary in world space (Z axis, positive = bottom).

SkyboxPath.description: Asset path to the skybox .rtex texture. Empty string uses the default skybox.

Coordinates.description: Named rectangular regions accessible at runtime via IGameAPI.GetCoordinate(name).

Units.description: Pre-placed unit and building instances on the map.

Props.description: Pre-placed decorative prop instances on the map.

Decals.description: Pre-placed flat texture decal instances on the terrain.

Vfx.description: Pre-placed ambient visual effect emitter instances on the map.

Coordinate.description: A named rectangular region used to reference map areas from MapScript.cs via IGameAPI.GetCoordinate.

Name.description: Unique name for this region. Used as the key in IGameAPI.GetCoordinate(name).

Min.description: The minimum corner of the bounding box in world space.

Max.description: The maximum corner of the bounding box in world space.

PlacedEntity.description: A pre-placed unit or building instance.

UnitId.description: The unit type identifier from metadata.json CustomUnits or CustomBuildings.

PlayerSlot.description: Zero-based player slot index that owns this entity.

PlacedProp.description: A pre-placed decorative prop (non-interactive environment object).

PropId.description: The prop asset identifier (filename without extension, e.g. 'crystal_cluster_29').

PlacedDecal.description: A pre-placed flat texture projected onto the terrain surface.

DecalId.description: The decal texture asset identifier (filename without extension).

PlacedVfx.description: A pre-placed ambient visual effect emitter.
